info.name: Buyselles Partner API v1
info.description:
Complete Partner/Reseller API for Buyselles.com marketplace.

## Setup (2 steps)

1. Collection **Variables**: set `base_url`, `api_key`, `api_secret`
2. Open a request → **Params** tab → fill the values → Send

**No JSON body needed** — all POST data is sent as URL params (query string).

**Check `order_requirements` on product detail** (`GET /products/{id}`) — only fill params listed for your product's `fulfillment_type` and `pricing_type`.

| Request | Use when |
|---------|----------|
| Create Order (simple) | Fixed price, supplier codes (Bamboo), or optional denomination on fixed products |
| Create Order (denomination) | `pricing.type` is `denominations` (required selection) |
| Create Order (direct top-up) | `fulfillment_type` is `direct_topup` |

request.description: Use Postman Runner with 65+ iterations to trigger the 60 req/min rate limit. Expect 429 responses after the 60th request within a minute.

**IP Whitelist Behavior:**

- If `allowed_ips` is **empty** → ALL IPs are allowed (open mode, useful for development)
- If `allowed_ips` has entries → ONLY those IPs are allowed; all others get 403

This is why 127.0.0.1 works even without explicit whitelisting — the list is empty.

To restrict access: add specific IPs in the Vendor Developer > IP Whitelist section.
